problem.description: `sign_in_again` when the vendor refused the refresh, `refresh_failing` while a renewal retries.

waiting.description: Turns waiting because the plan reached its usage limit, while it is the provider in use.

verification_uri.description: Opens xAI's approval page with the code filled in.

blocked.description: A turn of this task waits for a person: to retry it, raise a budget or stop it.

owner.description: The login of the person it belongs to.

reading.description: A person's message waits for the orchestrator.

room_id.description: The room whose messages and events carry the task's conversation.

title.description: The orchestrator's name for the task; `None` until its first answer.

position.description: The number the agent knows it by.

instructions.description: Added to the orchestrator's own instructions.

max_agents.description: Most agents one round of work may involve.

max_rounds.description: Rounds of follow-up work the orchestrator may start before it asks the person.

oneOf.description: With `model`, what the orchestrator thinks with; empty means the connection agents use.

Trigger.description: A connection event that runs a routine (docs/adr/agents.md#scheduled-and-event-triggered-work).

event.description: One of its connector's event kinds, such as `mail.received`.

attachments.description: Files the agent sent with this reply.

oneOf.description: Set when this message is a whole voice call, whose turns it holds.

children.description: Work this turn delegated or sent to other agents.

oneOf.description: Where the request came from when a person did not send it here directly.
Replaces the earlier context for later model requests; the source history remains.
A steering message entered the context.
Memory changes staged during the turn commit with it, or not at all.
`None` keeps the current cube; not part of the revision history.

broadcast.description: Whether the agent may broadcast to every agent; `None` keeps the current setting.

knowledge_base.description: Whether the agent may use the knowledge base; `None` keeps the current setting.

task_lanes.description: Concurrent delegated tasks, one to four; `None` keeps the current setting.

UpdateConnection.description: Each field present replaces the current one; changed settings or secrets are checked again.

agent.description: The agent whose own item this is; an installation item when absent.
